activity.role: Chairman of the Revolutionary Command Council
activity.notes: Muammar Gaddafi led the 1 September 1969 overthrow of the Libyan monarchy and became chairman of the Revolutionary Command Council, the supreme political authority of the newly established Libyan Arab Republic. This Activity ends on 2 March 1977 because that constitutional transition replaced the Libyan Arab Republic with the Jamahiriya system and dissolved the RCC; it does not imply that Gaddafi's broader de facto control of Libya ended in 1977.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969-1976: Libya - Revolutionary Command Council
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Office of the Historian identifies Muammar Qadhafi as chairman of Libya's Revolutionary Command Council and the dominant figure in the revolutionary regime established after 1969.

sources.title: Libya: Declaration on the Establishment of the Authority of the People
sources.citation_text: The 2 March 1977 declaration records the constitutional establishment of the new people's-authority system, providing the exact transition boundary used to close the Libyan Arab Republic Activity.
